Our licensed electricians combine technical expertise with exceptional customer service to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient solutions. Whether you need a simple repair or a complete rewiring, we're here to help.

faqs.question: How do I know if my panel needs upgrading?
faqs.answer: Signs include flickering lights, frequent breaker trips, or an old fuse box. We offer free inspections to assess your panel's condition.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranties on residential work?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our work comes with a warranty on labor and parts. Details vary by project.

faqs.question: What qualifies as an electrical emergency?
faqs.answer: Any situation that poses a safety risk, such as exposed wires, burning smells, or total power loss, is an emergency.

faqs.question: How fast can you arrive?
faqs.answer: We aim for same-day arrival, often within 1-2 hours for emergencies within Dallas.

Arrow Electrical specializes in panel upgrades to 200 amps or more, ensuring your system can handle modern appliances, electronics, and HVAC systems. We handle everything from permits to final inspection.

about.headline: Your Trusted Dallas Electrician Since 1998
about.mission: To provide safe, reliable, and affordable electrical services that exceed customer expectations, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and integrity.
story: Arrow Electrical Contractors was founded in 1998 by master electrician John Arrow with a simple mission: deliver top-quality electrical work with honesty and transparency. Starting with a single truck and a commitment to excellence, John built a reputation for reliability that spread through Dallas neighborhoods. Over the years, Arrow Electrical has grown into a full-service electrical company serving thousands of residential and commercial clients.

Today, our team of licensed electricians continues that tradition. We invest in ongoing training, use the latest tools and technology, and prioritize customer satisfaction above all. Whether it's a small repair or a major installation, we treat every project with the same care and attention to detail. Arrow Electrical — proud to be Dallas's trusted electrician.
